06 / GOOD QUESTIONS

Know before
you connect.

A few things worth understanding about automated trading.

What is included in the 30-day free access?

Eligible users get 30 days of EarnLikePro AI access with no installation fee and no subscription fee during that period. A trading account with our recommended broker is required. Trading capital and broker charges are separate.

What happens after 30 days?

Contact us through Telegram for the continuation options and full terms before activating access. This page does not promise ongoing free access beyond 30 days.

Do I need trading experience?

Manual trade execution experience is not required to operate a properly configured bot. You should still understand trading risks, your settings and how to monitor or stop the system.

Do I place trades myself?

Once activated and configured, the bot executes eligible trades according to its programmed strategy. Regular monitoring remains important.

Which platforms and markets are supported?

Confirm the supported trading platform, instruments and broker account type during onboarding before opening or funding an account.

Does EarnLikePro hold my money?

No trading capital is transferred to EarnLikePro as part of this free-access process. Your trading funds remain in your own broker account.

Can I withdraw or stop the bot?

Withdrawals are handled by your broker under its terms. You can stop automated trading; check any open positions and account requirements first.

Does automation guarantee profits?

No. A trading bot can incur losses. Automated execution and risk controls cannot guarantee returns or eliminate market risk.
